verdict.rationale: Circle documents the pieces for fiat settlement. Circle Mint lets qualified businesses convert USDC to and from USD at no additional cost, and USDC/EURC are redeemable 1:1 for fiat. CPN delivers local fiat payouts through partners, with a managed mode where Circle handles treasury and settlement. However, nothing in the evidence describes a merchant payment-acceptance flow that automatically converts incoming stablecoin receipts into a fiat balance or bank payout. A finance lead would have to assemble this from Mint redemption and payout rails, and Mint requires a qualified-business application. Missing for 10: a documented auto-convert/auto-settle-to-fiat option for incoming crypto payments, a documented bank payout flow for the merchant's own receipts, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
